correctness.rationale: For d≥3 and 0<a<1 the removed corner simplices are disjoint; on a torus cell only 2^d translates may occur. Two removed addresses must have Hamming distance 1 since the sum of their deficits is at least their Hamming distance but less than 2a<2. The cube graph has no triangles, so at most two losses. An edge event has exact volume 2h^d/d!, and disjoint edge events give p2. The mean 2^d a^d/d! and exact p2 determine p1,p0. Parseval and L²= L+2 1_{L=2} yield the Fourier-energy formula. The d-th derivative jump is 2^{d+1}d. The included 15 finite mesh cases check normalization but are not the proof.
